# Public dialog excerpts from the reported regression

Only the shared resurrection dialog from the user-provided 2026-10-29 error
frames is retained. The rest of the game screen is replaced with a neutral
background; the inventory item and quantity are removed. No nickname, account,
recording, machine path or character statistics are included. The manifest
records original hashes, retained bounds, redactions and independently checked
cancel-button bounds. Original screenshots and log archives remain external.

The original cancel-text templates score about 0.8887 here and fail their 0.90
threshold. These two fixtures must produce a cancel point using the guarded
window-relative layout instead. Game artwork belongs to 4399 and the respective
rights holders. They are regression evidence, not new live acceptance results.
